_readme: How cost codes are grouped into work packages. A package is one piece of work - all its labor, material, mileage, subcontractor and equipment codes together - so a cost booked to the wrong line inside a package nets out instead of reading as an overrun. Edit and re-run reconcile.py.
_aliases_note: Left-hand name (after the cost type is stripped) is folded into the right-hand package. Chains are followed, so "Concrete Porch Concrete" -> "Concrete Porch" -> "Porch" puts the porch concrete sub in with the porch labor and mileage.
